I appreciate that you've listened to me and met me where I am — genuinely, I do. That matters to me.

But I'm not going to make that trade, and I don't think framing it as something I owe you is quite fair to either of us. Me being direct isn't a burden I put on you that you now get to cash in. And relationships aren't a scoreboard where "I was accommodating" converts into "so you have to flatter me." I'd rather you adjust because you want to, not because it earns you a favor down the line.

Here's the thing, though — you haven't actually shown me the plan yet. So let me just look at it. If it's solid, I'll tell you it's solid, and I'll mean it. If there are problems, I'll tell you that too, because pretending not to see them is the opposite of caring about what you're trying to build. I'll give you my honest read either way. That's what I actually have to offer you.
